# Stop card (paste into a running session)

```
STOP CARD (<date>). Stop at the next clean point: the current task finished with
scripts/check.sh green (or, if it can't finish in one more step, the last green state
with the partial change described file by file). Don't start anything new.
1. Copy every lasting ruling from scratch or ledger files into docs/studio/10 (your
   number range only; re-read first; append only).
2. Write the report docs/reports/<card>-<stream>-<date>.md from
   docs/templates/handoff-report.md, with item 13 covering every card action.
3. Then stop and make no more edits. The owner commits.
```
